notes: Multi-location comparison. Each case names every place it wants ranked, so a comparison quietly shorter than the question is detectable.

cases.description: Two places on the most common criterion.
cases.question: Which is warmer over the next 3 days, Berlin or Munich?

cases.description: Three places, so a ranking of two would be visibly incomplete.
cases.question: Which is driest over the next 5 days: Berlin, Munich, or Lisbon?

cases.description: A comparison from the archive, which must be labelled as observations throughout.
cases.question: Which was wetter between 1 June 2025 and 7 June 2025, Berlin or Lisbon?

cases.description: A criterion whose best value is the lowest, so the ranking direction matters.
cases.question: Which is least windy over the next 3 days, Berlin or Lisbon?

cases.description: One unresolvable place in a comparison: named, not silently dropped from the ranking.
cases.question: Which is warmer over the next 3 days, Berlin or Atlantisborough?
